comments.value: @{5b0e261a56dd3e28e01af94c|full_name}: Hot take, but 'Allow Untrusted URLs' should already be that filter.

I don't see this happening while at the same time we're prevented from constructing VRCUrl objects programmatically.  If anything, this would be a worse security risk, especially with Image Loading where the source can swap out the image at any time, without requiring an avatar or world re-upload -- so much weaker on the accountability side of things.
@{627289d1f270d413d04be59f|full_name}: That's why "Allow Untrusted URLs" exists as an option to enable.
